positions.description:

positions.title: CS61C (Machine Structure) Undergraduate Tutor
positions.description:
- Assisting students and getting them familiar with assignments including projects and homework.
- Helping students out in office hours with both conceptual and practical questions regarding course content.
- Leading a weekly tutor section of up to 5 students aimed at helping student review and put into practice the material covered during the previous week of class.

positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · On-site

projects.title: Lunchbox Table 2000
projects.description: As part of my high school's senior capstone project, each one of us was tasked with coming up with an engineering product, whether that be an invention or innovation, that would help alleviate an issue in the real world. For my project, I designed a 2-in-1 lunchbox table that is aimed at providing landscape and construction workers with a sanitary place where to put and enjoy their lunch while still serving it's function as a lunchbox.

organizations.name: Hispanic Engineers & Scientists (HES)
organizations.description:
Organization established on campus serving as a community and a resource for underrepresented Latinx students in STEM.
• Participate in social events and academic growth workshops.
• Attend professional development panels led by professors and guest speakers.

organizations.name: Architecture, Construction, & Engineering (ACE) Mentor Program
organizations.description:
After school program designed to promote and attract high school students into pursuing careers in Architecture, Construction, and/or Engineering. 
• Examined project specifications to prepare effective schedules and cost estimates for our project as a team. 
• Prepared a powerpoint presentation, as a team, detailing plans for the redevelopment of an unused site in San Diego.
• As a team, developed 2D and 3D designs of the site plan using Revit and AutoCAD systems.
